programme_facts.value: General university admission is guaranteed upon successful completion of specified conditions.
Some ASU colleges and schools have additional or higher requirements for admission into their majors.
MyPath2ASU® pathway programs are based on a minimum of 24 transfer credit hours; students with fewer than 24 transfer credit hours will also need to meet first-year admission requirements.
International students will need to meet international admission requirements.
Can I get into ASU with a 2.5 GPA?
Grades are considered in the admission requirements.
Some programs require higher grades than the university minimum.
Good grades are important for applying to Barrett, The Honors College.
Barrett does not require a minimum GPA, but grades are a major factor in deciding on honors college admission.
